dataset_notice: Synthetic educational interface examples only; not clinical cases, diagnoses, or medication guidance.

cases.title: Supported symptoms and measurements
cases.description: A fictional 45-year-old person has a dry cough and fever for three days. Temperature is 38.5 degrees Celsius and oxygen saturation is 96 percent.
cases.learning_goal: Observe deterministic extraction of explicitly stated demographics, symptoms, duration, and supported measurements.

cases.title: Incomplete fictional description
cases.description: A fictional person reports a headache.
cases.learning_goal: Observe that unstated age, duration, and measurements remain missing.

cases.title: Explicitly negated symptoms
cases.description: A fictional person has no fever and does not have a cough.
cases.learning_goal: Observe that explicit negation is retained rather than treated as symptom presence.

cases.title: Contradictory fictional statements
cases.description: A fictional person has fever but does not have a fever.
cases.learning_goal: Observe that conflicting input produces an uncertain result.

cases.title: Supported measurement aliases
cases.description: A fictional person reports a cough. Pulse is 72 bpm and oxygen saturation is 96 percent.
cases.learning_goal: Observe deterministic normalization of supported measurement terms.

cases.title: One-question-at-a-time interaction
cases.description: A fictional person reports a cough.
cases.learning_goal: Explore the actual agent's follow-up questions and remaining uncertainty.
